description: This file defines the SeoUrl model class for the OpenCart catalog module, providing methods to retrieve SEO URL information from the database based on keywords or key-value pairs.

classes.name: SeoUrl
classes.description: Model class responsible for fetching SEO URL data based on keywords or key-value pairs from the database.

methods.name: getSeoUrlByKeyword
methods.description: Retrieves SEO URL information from the database that matches the given keyword.

methods.name: getSeoUrlByKeyValue
methods.description: Retrieves SEO URL information based on specific key and value pair.
